name: Governing Law
title: Governing Law
text: This Policy is governed by the laws of India. It is to be read with, and does not exclude or limit, the rights and remedies of a consumer under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

legal_basis.note: The Act is in addition to, and not in derogation of, any other law
An unfair contract term includes one that excludes a consumer's statutory rights

invalid_if: The policy purports to oust the consumer's statutory remedies or to require arbitration of a consumer complaint
authoring_note: D4.48. Replaces CORE_GOVERNING_LAW_001 and the CORE_DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_001 that the dependency resolver attached to it. A consumer policy that refers 'any dispute between the Parties' to a sole arbitrator reads as an attempt to take the consumer out of the Consumer Commission. The route a consumer has is in ECOM_GRIEVANCE_REDRESSAL_001 (Grievance Officer, then the Commission). The advocate should confirm the Section 100 and Section 2(46) citations.
